reviews.text: Great vets all the staff are always very friendly and the vets never make you feel rushed in the appointments they also don’t try to push you into buying stuff from them or paying for optional tests and things but just let you know it’s available which I feel a lot of vets make it feel more like a sales pitch rather than to look after your animals and I really appreciate that I feel more likely to purchase there items because of that. Both my cats are always super relaxed during there appointments would definitely recommended this vets to others
Awesome place

UNSUPPASSABLE.
I urge every owner who, like me , cannot  imagine life without their dog (or any other type of pet) to
entrust their pets health and longevity to Creature Comforts.
Very friendly staff, lots of treats. Overall, a lovely place!
Kash had his first visit here today and he loved it! The staff are wonderful and made Kash feel right at home. And the aesthetic inside the vet brings amazing chilled vibes
Would highly recommend this place. The whole process was very easy got an appointment same day and saw Dr Thy who made sure my cat was comfortable and explained everything very clearly

Brilliant experience, kept the anxious dog (and anxious owner) calm and clearly addressed every worry/issue I had. They were patient, identified necessary treatment, followed up with email summaries of everything discussed and even gave us a goodie bag with my dog’s name and a heart! To anyone who is worried about bringing reactive dogs to the vet, please don’t be as they clearly know what they are doing and are here to help!

Always been a pleasant experience, I’m a member of your services and find it very helpful if I need an appointment quickly. My dog loves visiting and is always desperate to pop in if we pass by. The girls are all very helpful and accommodating
Always a great experience with Creature Comforts Vets. They’re consistently kind and empathetic to my dog Louis. Thank you Dr Jess!

Amazing experience! I’ve just joined this veterinary practice and I couldn’t be happier. The clinic is extremely clean, modern and welcoming, and the service was fantastic from the moment we arrived.

Everyone was so friendly and professional, and they treated Kenzo with so much care and kindness. Most importantly, Mary, the vet, took the time to properly investigate the problem and was able to identify exactly what was causing his discomfort.
I’m really, really happy with the service and feel very reassured knowing Kenzo is in such good hands. Highly recommended! 🐾❤️

I went for the first time to Creature Comforts today with my puppy for a health check. Honestly I was blown away by the facilities and the staff. Its so so nice in there and the staff are all lovely. I saw Dr. Marie who was also amazing. I could not recommend this place enough

We changed to Creature Comforts vet practise recently as my Border Terrier had become so stressed visiting our previous vet.  CC have been brilliant at making her recent visits a calm, fun experience and I feel now that she can be taken to the vet without stress or drama.  They have thought of everything down to making the premises smell lovely with their signature scent and having baskets of tennis balls and jars of goodies to please everyone! The cleanliness and calm atmosphere is also very welcome. The staff are so kind and welcoming. It gets 5* from us!

I brought my dog Dylan in for his initial assessment after joining up and was struck by how professional the setup was, we were welcomed with a coffee by the very friendly receptionist… the vet who saw him, Jess, had a great manner, she took a real interest in Dylan, and I felt like everyone there has a genuine love for the animals in their care

I’m confident that if he needs any future care  that he’ll be in good hands

100% recommend, our Labrador had a lovely vet visit. He usually hates strangers and it makes us really nervous having to do things like vet visits. We took him in a couple of days before the appointment and he had the best time, he thought he was in ball heaven, with the two huge baskets of tennis balls at the door. The staff were so good and let him sniff around, he warmed to everyone straight away without any barking at all. I would go so far as to say he is even excited to visit the vet now, which I never thought we would achieve. They are well equipped for all animals and extremely good if you have any sort of nervous / anxious / reactive dog. Thanks team Balham for making me feel at ease!
Great experience and lovely staff.
Wonderful vets and staff. So good with Ozzy they treat him as their own. I'm sure he'd stay given the chance and treats! It also smells really nice in there
Had to rush my dog in for eating raisins and the team was ready and saw him immediately. Walked me through everything and made sure Dwayne was cuddled and as comfortable as could be.

Charlotte had her first appointment with Jess, who gave her a thorough check up, vaccine & a few treats to distract her.  She had a great time looking through the peephole window at other animals in the waiting area.  After being sent home with a goodie bag the whole experience for her was calm enjoyable and best of all so much cheaper than it can be at other vets.  The surgery itself has such friendly staff and an almost 'animal spa' like feel to it.  Coffee or tea on arrival, a beautiful waiting area with little cubby hole areas for cats when there might be a dog around. All very zen.  Very generous also with free tennis balls, bandanas & treats.  I am so glad I signed Charlotte up for the care plan, she no spring chicken anymore so it makes perfect sense, I can take her in for free as many times as I need to in any of their surgerys in the UK.  Creature Comfors definitely put animals first & removing that feeling of being financially totally stung!  I highly recommend this vet group.  It's the kind of place you can drop by and say hello and be met with smiles and a warm welcome.
Big thanks to Georgia she helped me with my pack of dogs and recommended a great vets professional and helpful

I've found Creature Comforts a complete dream. The clinic is so calm and friendly. I saw Dr. Marie, who was lovely with my dog, explained things thoroughly and answered every question I had. I now feel very clear and reassured on where my dog's treatment goes next, which is something that was really lacking with my last vet. It was such a nice experience for both me and my dog, who was thrilled to go home with a bag of treats.

I also can't believe how good their app is. Shortly after my appointment, I had a message on the app explaining the next recommended procedure (including what will happen on the day) and what it will cost. The attention to detail is excellent. I massively recommend them.

10/10 my two fur babies actually enjoy seeing the vets. The team are fab and normally Ernie and Betty are so so scared of going to the vets. Also the clinic is calming environment. Thank you from Ernie and Betty 🫶🙏 …

Excellent service, georgia was very helpful at front desk and thr vet marie is wonderful with phoenix.

I need to add, this vet is amazing! We had an emergency over the weekend with one of our other cats and they had an appointment the very next day for him to be seen on Monday, and procedures booked for Tuesday morning, they are so friendly and caring and once again DR marie is amazing! The front desk was once again on point, offered me a drink and a place to sit while I waited, highly highly recommend creature comforts balham for anyone looking for a local vet in the area! They even send pictures while they have your babies in their care!

(The ginger one is faz who had the emergency and the other is our maine coon phoenix who is 10 months that they first met)
True professionals. Dedicated, incredibly kind and extremely practical. Thank you for taking care of us!
Best vet experience I’ve ever had , all the staff were so kind and made us feel at home ! They even gave boba a little good bag before we left!

Hi Aaron, 
Thanks so much for the 5-stars! 🤩 …

I can’t say enough good things about CC! Every visit with my one year old miniature schnauzer, Bertie, is such a positive experience. The vets and nurses are incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely caring. Bertie literally drags me inside because he’s so excited for all the affection and cuddles he gets. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a wonderful vet team!

Hi Rosa,
Thank you for the 4 stars! 💕 …

Couldn’t recommend Creature Comforts enough! My dog Rhubarb loves it there - the staff are so friendly, the vets/nurses are excellent and the service / atmosphere / look and feel is exceptional. Coffee on arrival, treat wall for the pets and free tennis balls for Rhu - 10/10
Welcoming, clean and friendly. Made our pet feel very safe.  They don’t rush you and allow you to ask questions and give helpful answers.  Would highly recommend

I’ve just joined Creature Comforts and have been so impressed with the experience so far. Before joining, I visited and was shown around the premises, which are incredibly clean and welcoming. All the staff I’ve met have been super friendly, helpful and approachable, and the communication and support have been excellent throughout.

My dog, Solomon, is usually quite scared of going to the vet, so I couldn’t believe the difference at his welcome appointment — he was jumping around, happy and completely at ease! That alone says a lot about the atmosphere they’ve created.

It feels like a small, friendly and genuinely approachable practice where you and your pet are treated as individuals. I’m really glad I made the move across to Creature Comforts and feel very confident that Solomon is in good hands. Highly recommended!
Couldn’t imagine a better vet experience - it’s literally third space for dogs! Pet and pet owner heaven! Also there was a lovely receptionist (who owns a golden retriever)

So so lovely! From the minute we walked in it felt more like a spa than a vets. Everyone was so kind. I had a coffee and my incredibly nervous dig was fussed over to make her feel more comfortable. The. The vet got on the floor with her rather than putting her on the table to check her over. It really was a lovely experience. My dog even received a little goodie bag!! Very happy!
Happy first visit to creature comforts Balham. Super relaxing experience for the dog with dr Jess and great customer service for the human!

Creature Comforts Balham are so wonderful! Our dog, Bruce, used to be terrified of the vets and would shake uncontrollably when we went anywhere near the old vets, he couldn’t be more different here! The team are so kind and gentle and Bruce particularly enjoys the treat pick and mix on the way in. We also love the monthly subscription aspect and how we are encouraged to bring him in regularly for nail clippings etc and even just to stop by and get a coffee and say hi, to get him used to the space being not a negative place for him. It’s made the world of difference to him and our nerves taking him to the vets, highly recommend

Recently moved to Balham and needed to find a new vet for my big German shepherd…had my first visit to Creature Comforts and was really impressed. Friendly greeting on arrival, lots of love and attention for my dog. Dr Victor was super friendly, knowledgeable, and was great with my doggo. Definitely feel like we’ve found the perfect vet for us. Highly recommend!

We cannot recommend Creature Comforts highly enough. It is by far the best practice we have been to. The practice has a calm feel, and puts us and our kitten Coconut at ease.

When Coconut became critically ill, the practice’s care and support helped him make a full recovery and now he is as sassy as ever. They also made the admin burden very easy for us in what was a difficult time. We are so grateful for them going above and beyond for him.

We have seen Dr Jess the most, who is really knowledgeable and helps us keep an eye and mitigate potential issues for the future. She and all the staff are genuinely invested in his health and give him lots of cuddles when he comes in!

This is the practice to choose if you want your fur baby to get the most attentive treatment possible.

Brilliant service, amazing staff. Just love the zen calming atmosphere the minute you walk through the door. Often you go to the vets stressed, animals stressed, feeling emotional. Not here. The atmosphere is absolutely impeccable, calming and soothing. No bright lights, no loud noises. Service is incredible, seen quickly - no long waits. Both customer and animals treated like royalty. It’s about time we had a vet practice this brilliant. Also should mention the monthly access plan. Brilliant idea! Softens the blow when you get back to reception.

Thankyou all so much at Balham creature comforts 🥰
Fantastic service as part of their membership. Our dog gets excited every time she goes. Nothing is too much trouble with very friendly team.

My first time at the vets here in Balham and wow was I impressed. The team are so caring for both the animal and human guests .
The layout of the surgery is so calming and well thought through colour schemes and comfort for the guasts ensuring the place doesn’t have fear in the air, coffee and charging stations devices for the humans .
The consultation rooms are well set up and calm there  are trats  for the pets to calm them down . Tillie that’s my cat has never been so well behaved and calm it’s a pleasure .
Looking at long term I also signed up to the monthly scheme I think it’s great value . Thanks to the entire team for making this a pleasure .
Cheers
Ric

I took my cay suzie she's 19 years old and I was so worried coz she was really down She had a fall MOT and everything was fine think the hot weather hit her hard the vets were lovely suzie is so happy now and back being my lap cat TY

I cannot recommend Creature Comforts Balham enough! From the moment you walk through the door, the staff treat my pup Chewie like royalty. They have such a gentle, loving approach that turned what used to be a scary errand for my dog into fun times for my corgi, it's always a positive visit. 10/10 service every single time.

Ella my Australian labradoodle was so excited when she realised she was going to the vet this morning, quite unlike any previous vet visit!
Everyone at the Creature Comforts clinic was welcoming and friendly,  Victor the vet was kind and reassuring and there was no hard selling of products.
Highly recommended!
Lovely experience at our first ever visit to the vets with our puppy. Everyone made her feel so comfortable and fussed over

I can’t recommend the Balham team highly enough, particularly Marie, who was absolutely brilliant with my new rescue, Patrick (“Chips”).

Patrick turned up on my doorstep about a month ago as a hungry, scraggly stray, so we knew very little about him. We took him in for a weight check, an age estimate, his first vaccines and a microchip.

I was expecting the whole experience to be a bit of an ordeal, but Marie was fantastic. She distracted him with a lick treat while giving him his vaccine and microchip, and managed to calm him down (and, importantly, me!) almost immediately. She was so gentle and reassuring with him throughout.

The whole team were incredibly kind, too — even when Patrick decided to leave a rather smelly little “present” in his carrier! They cleaned it all up for me without a fuss, which I really appreciated.

He even left with a little bag of treats, so I’m hoping getting him back into his carrier for his next vaccines might be slightly less of a farce than it was this time.

Although, judging by the photo of him happily sitting in his now-clean carrier, I think he’s already forgiven us. 😂

The most amazing team and lovely facilities. They always take such great care of my cat whenever I bring her in and were very proactive and attentive when I brought her in for her spay. I have only good experiences.

You have the best veterinary team. The clinic in Balham is beautiful, and my dog is always so happy to see the vet. The care, professionalism, and customer service are truly exceptional. I honestly cannot think of anything else you could do to improve the experience—thank you for always looking after us so well.

Wish I could go here instead of my GP ! The surgery is very nicely designed, smells gorgeous and the receptionists are very welcoming. The vet was really nice and my new puppy had a great first experience of the vet.After her examination she was given a treat and a goodie bag to take home.Prices seem very clear and reasonable. I took out the annual plan which seemed the best value.Top marks from me and Nellie.  Would definitely recommend.

Such a lovely veterinary practice with genuinely great staff. Everyone is friendly, caring and makes you feel very welcome.

My dog absolutely loves coming here and feels so comfortable and relaxed, which is a huge difference compared with how he normally feels at his usual vet. That alone says so much about how well the team treats the animals and makes them feel safe.

I would happily change to this practice permanently if I wasn’t moving away. I’m really grateful for the care he has received and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a kind, professional and caring vet.

Very easy to book. The staff at the Balham surgery are amazing and very friendly. I got many updates and photos via the app while my dog was in for sedation and x-rays! 100% recommend. Signed up for a membership!
Hi Sara, thank you for the 5-stars!! 💕 …

Friendly and personal vet experience! They always remember my dog and provide amazing care when she needs it. Live chat function on their app is so handy and often can get same day appointments when needed. Highly recommend

It was such a seamless process to go online and sign up for a monthly payment plan and book the first appointment and follow up appointment. The premises look like a spa ! The staff are efficient, friendly and extremely competent and empathetic. My elderly dog returned from kennels with a sore paw and she was seen very quickly and was given medication for pain and antibiotics and a follow up appointment. With the monthly £15 subscription the bill was a fraction of the price that I would have paid at my previous vet.
The staff at Creature Comforts Balham are so lovely! They really seems to care to my pooch. Love the membership subscription too - makes things much simpler.
The people in this practice are incredible. Marie looked after my dog, ensuring he wasn’t stressed or uncomfortable.

Where do I begin.. the staff were so unbelievably kind, patient, and made me feel like decisions were collaborative and in the best interests of Jensen (my dog) rather than financially incentivised. The space itself has been intentionally designed, it’s relaxing (for the owner) and there’s so many thoughtful features to help with anxious pets. I have to shoutout Jessica and Katie, both who went above and beyond to make me feel reassured. Jensen was incredibly poorly, but they were both thorough and I felt in very safe hands. Another shoutout to the ladies on reception and other members of staff who made Jensen feel so safe in what can be a very nerving environment, I was constantly offered coffee/drinks and made to feel well looked after as well as Jensen. A gorgeous and happy environment, everyone genuinely looks happy to work there which is rare for a Vets. Thank you Creature Comforts Balham!!
Hi Tom, thanks for the 5 stars! ⭐
Lovely vets practice with everyone incredibly friendly and professional.  Our dog loves the place too.
Recently switched to this practice, and have had a wonderful experience. They are incredibly kind and helpful. And treat my girl really well.

We recently changed vets, and Creatures Comfort has been amazing. From the moment you walk in, everyone is so helpful, welcoming, and friendly, and the clinic has such a calm, spa-like vibe.

Peaches was treated like a princess. She even had her own dedicated nook to help her feel safe and relaxed. You can really see how thoughtful and thorough they are. They pay attention to every detail and make sure all the animals are well cared for and as comfortable as possible. She even got some treats, which she absolutely loved, and enjoyed a little stroll around the waiting area.
Dr. Bernhardi was incredibly welcoming, calm, patient, and took the time to listen to and answer all of our questions. Peaches was so well looked after, and I loved that the whole experience was easy and completely stress-free.

I also love that they have a user-friendly app that’s easy to navigate. The staff are always easy to reach, quick to reply, and happy to help resolve any queries.
It’s so refreshing to finally have a vet that makes booking appointments so easy and genuinely cares about the wellbeing of our fur babies. I’m so happy we made the switch and highly recommend Creatures Comfort to anyone looking for a caring, professional, and compassionate veterinary practice.

Great local vet - was thrilled with the team who were so incredibly sweet to my very nervous little kitten. Appointment was super easy to set up - and the summer discount on the membership access was great. The waiting area has a nice quiet cat nook to keep them calm ahead of seeing their vet, which I appreciated - and the exam rooms feel calm and welcoming. I went from having a nervous kitten to one exploring around and enjoying a little chin scratch. Really appreciate the care and kindness from the team - from front desk to vet team - all around stars.

My 11 year old cockapoo had a Senior Clinic review with a lovely veterinary nurse who put my mind to rest on the potential problems of older age after a thorough check and questionnaire. She also dealt with his anal glands expression in a highly professional but very sensitive way. Would absolutely recommend Balham Creature Comforts to any pet owner!

Excellent costumer service, friendly staff, clean nice space and upfront or well display prices on everything for your pet (online and at the vet). Appointment bookings are easy and straight forward on the app, meaning you do not need to call or send emails, etc. I cannot recommend them enough.
Thank you for the 5 stars Laura! 🤩 …

We visited for the first time today. Our dog is reactive towards other dogs so the vets were super accommodating to make sure we’re booked in at a time no other dogs were there and also let us wait in a private room in case any other dogs came in. The vet was so lovely and made our dog feel so comfortable and happy while getting her check up. Definitely recommend! Thank you again to the amazing team.
First time and my experience was very impressive. Great staff and the environment was amazing. My cat was not stressed.
Teddy had a problem with his front leg. Victor the vet was very professional and the front of practice staff were excellent. Just joined and was really impressed.

Victor was incredibly kind, friendly, and helpful throughout our visit. He answered all of my questions with patience, listened carefully to my concerns, and made the whole experience feel welcoming and stress-free. I really appreciated the time and care he took to help us.

The rest of the team were also wonderful, friendly, attentive, and so thoughtful. They even gave our two little cats Nala and Malo, some treats, which was such a lovely touch. We’re very grateful for the excellent service and would highly recommend them!

An absolutely fantastic experience for myself and my beautiful puppy Rockabun.
This was my first visit. I found everyone very friendly.
I signed up for membership after looking on their website and seeing what they offer. I personally think it is very good value for money.
Went again yesterday, just for a quick check and to get my Rockabun flea and worm tablets. It is always nice to visit the vet when it is not serious and as usual visiting Creature Comforts where everyone is so welcoming is a great experience.
I have also had to visit for one or two emergencies and still I know my puppy is in excellent hands.

This vets practice has been a real god send when trying to put medication in my cocker spaniel puppy’s ears. My dog has been there a lot of days in a row and they are always so helpful and lovely with her. She runs to get there she loves it so much!
Fantastic Vets! Would recommend always, fast and effective.
Great place, affordable deals and prices, very patient vet answered all my odd questions. Love the app idea and the monthly subscription plans! You guys doing a great job in there

Rosie is always happy to head into Creature Comforts: she loves the attention from all the friendly staff members. She has regular monthly injections but never feels them as she's so occupied with the treats and fuss she's getting.

A few weeks ago Creature Comforts helped us with the hardest possible day. Our 12 year old bunny Flapjack had lost the use of his legs the night before and after much crying and giving him all the treats and cuddles we simply didn't have the heart to leave him helpless for the future. Because it was a weekend and our previous vet was closed we called Creature Comforts and they said they would help us. There are no words to describe what gentle care and perfect professionalism we received from the staff. They were big hearted, human, and vastly knowledgeable. They examined him, agreed that it was time, explained perfectly what would happen during the procedure, and most importantly, allowed us a lot of space in what must have been a busy day for them. Flapjacks last moments were filled with love and care. They then took him and a few days later returned his ashes to us in a beautiful little box with a signed card. Stephanie, Jessica, Katie, Marie, Within, Eden, Erin and Anouk... You are wonderful people and we thank you from the bottom of our heart for having chosen your profession. One day we will surely have another fluffy friend and when we do there is no question that we are coming back to you.  Flapjack would have loved you all.

had the BEST experience today at Creature Comforts Balham! My rescue dog is very nervous and has had several very bad experiences at his previous vet practice, but the staff were so kind and patient with him, even when he got scared and growled. Miles away from service I've received at other places - I could tell the staff loved animals and wanted him to be comfortable. They weren't phased by him being nervous but were instead so patient with him.

By the end of the visit he'd had a full body check over and was eating chicken happily. Prices were transparent and we had a good informed chat about follow up dental work, I felt very comfortable. We will be popping back in regularly for "social" visits to build up my dog's confidence in visiting the vet and I'm really glad this practice has opened up!
Thank you for the 5 stars Dani! 🤩 …

My previous vet was good, but this was a very impressive first visit- great premises and facilities - great staff and very easy to park next door ( eg Waitrose) . The membership deal is well worth it.

Absolutely LOVE Creature Comforts!
The staff, nurses and vets all know my boy by sight. He loves going: it means free treats, lots of cuddles and some ball play!
For me, it’s a comfortable, open, airconned space to chat about whatever it is I’m concerned about. And knowing I can take my boy in for anything his naughtiness can get into as part of his coverage is a weight off.

TL;DR : everyone is friendly and absolutely love the patients that come through the door. Highly recommend

We are so impressed with our experience I don’t even know where to begin with this review. The team at Creature Comforts were absolutely brilliant with our elderly Boston Terrier who was admitted for a scale, polish and six teeth extraction. As a dog owner I was hesitant about putting our senior dog through anaesthetic, but the vet went above and beyond with all the medical checks and pre blood work which eased our anxiety. They were so kind to send pictures of the team snuggling her, both pre & post op, and also incredibly caring to send updates throughout her procedure to keep our minds at ease. Everything was perfect and also surprisingly affordable for a vet practice which looks like a cowshed spa (love it). Thanks for looking after us. We’ll always choose to come back as it felt like a true family practice. X

From the moment I walked into Creature Comforts, I knew this was a very different kind of veterinary practice. You never really expect one vet to feel so different from another, but it genuinely does. You've completely changed my expectations of what a veterinary practice can be.

The practice is beautiful, spotless and smells amazing (something I never thought I'd mention in a vet review!), but more importantly, everyone is incredibly kind, calm and caring. The whole experience feels thoughtfully designed to make both pets and owners feel at ease.
A huge shoutout to Jessica,Katie and Georgia for taking such wonderful care of my two nervous cats, Cookie and Biscuit. Everyone has been so kind, patient and genuinely caring, and they've made every visit feel calm and stress-free.
Everyone was really friendly and my kitten was really comfortable being there!
What a great place! Always available, super friendly and such a great service. Thank you!

The vets at Creature Comfort were fantastic with my dog, Bluebell. They were kind, patient, and made her feel comfortable throughout her visit. They took the time to explain everything clearly and treated her with genuine care. I'm very grateful for the excellent service and would highly recommend Creature Comfort to anyone looking for compassionate, professional veterinary care. Thank you for taking such good care of Bluebell!

Our Miniature Dachshund Milo had a heart scan at Creature Comforts Balham on Saturday and he was the most relaxed I’d ever seen him at a vets, due to the caring professional and very dog friendly staff that made us and Milo very comfortable from the start. Thanks to Veterinary Nurse Katie, and Vet Marie for their amazing skills in keeping Milo relaxed during his procedure. 10/10
Excellent

Creature Comforts is simply the best vet experience ever. The Reception staff are polite, friendly and make customers and pets equally welcome. The vet was thorough, professional and kind in handling my dog. A fantastic addition to Balham offering an excellent, affordable service. I wish the Company good luck and best wishes for a continued great launch.
Very calm clean place to welcome your pet. The vet is very nice and gentle and reassuring. Wonderful care and good value for money. I thoroughly recommend.
The best vets and clinic I’ve ever seen. Can’t find any faults. From the staffs to the clinic, 5⭐️

My cat recently had dental work here. I was a little nervous because of his heart murmur. They did all they could to reassure me - showed me the surgery space, where he would stay after the treatment, and sent me regular updates so I knew when he was in, what they needed to do, and when he was out. His aftercare has been equally brilliant! Balham's best vet!
Great vet. Welcoming staff and calming environment. My kittens had a great experience at creatures comfors. Highly recommend
Second time here for my cat, the receptionist is lovely and the vet is so kind. Highly recommend this place.

Reception staff are lovely very welcoming and accommodating. The surgeons were also amazing made me feel very safe to leave my cat for her operation. Post op checks were offered 2/5 days after surgery which helped calm any worries regarding recovery. The staff are super friendly and you can tell they care deeply about the work they do honestly can’t thank you guys enough! X

Dear Team!

Thank you so much to Éibhín, Stephanie, and Dr Poppy for taking such wonderful care of Ralphie during his emergency appointment. From the moment we arrived, you showed such kindness, compassion, and professionalism, which made an incredibly stressful situation so much easier to manage.

Your expertise, thoroughness, and reassuring approach gave us real confidence that Ralphie was in the very best hands. You not only took excellent care of him, but you also took the time to comfort and reassure me, which meant more than I can say during such a worrying time.

We are so grateful for the care, attention, and genuine compassion you showed throughout. It is clear how much you all care about the animals you treat and the families who love them. We are incredibly fortunate to have such a fantastic local veterinary team serving our community.

Thank you again for everything you did for Ralphie. We will never forget the kindness you showed us. 🐾❤️

Manisha and Floofa
Creature comforts have been amazing from day 1 - putting our ease at mind that comes with the craziness of having a new puppy we couldn't ask for a better vet. Thank you!

Draco's first vet visit since his puppy jabs was a great experience! The team made him feel so loved and welcome, and he really enjoyed all the attention. Thank you for the lovely goodie bag too – he can't wait to come back next month!

We're so pleased we made the switch to here!

Our Howard was terrified of our previous vets and became very reactive. He is now so happy (munching on treats and getting pets) in a calm and friendly environment. Fantastic team, really knowledgeable. Five stars all round!

Brought my dog in for surgery today and from start to finish I was very pleased with the service provided. The ladies were so kind and helpful and I felt safe leaving my pup in their care, the areas are very clean and well kept I couldn’t recommend this place enough! Thank you ♥️

Cannot state this enough. The team are fantastic and their facilities are excellent. We brought our Mia in for a last minute visit and we felt so at ease the whole time.

We ended up signing up for their membership right away.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! 🤩 …
Very happy and welcoming team

Our Dogs simply love going to the Vet.
The Team are amazing, They really care about our Pets and make us anxious Humans feel less so.
Fully recommend this Team - so much more friendlier than our previous Vet, who only seemed to be interested in ushering us out of the Surgery.
Creature Comforts, Balham are the total opposite. From the moment you enter, you feel welcomed and treated as if you are the only Customer. They could certainly teach other Vets how to treat customers.
Give them a go, your furry friends will be treated so well.

Cannot reccommend this clinic enough!
We were worried about our cat's paw  and wanted a same day appointment which they had available on their website (they are running a very convenient 50% off weekdays appointment promotion).

As we arrived the team was warm and welcoming and offered us coffee, the waiting area was spotless (as was the examination room) and has little shaded nooks for cats so they can relax while waiting for their appointment, feromone sprays are also available.

Marie, our vet, was incredible with Mia and gave her a full exam rather than just looking at her paw, which we really loved.
When Mia's visit was over they had a goody bag prepared for her with some treats and little toy balls.

The whole experience was so positive we signed up for their memebership straight away.
